title: At a Restaurant: Ordering Food
situation: A customer sits down at a restaurant, asks for a menu, orders food, and asks for water.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa fadhiisanaya maqaayad, liiska cuntada codsanaya, cunto dalbanaya, kadibna biyo weydiinaya.
key_phrases: Can I see the menu, please?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. Is this restaurant open? Do you have a table for one?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Maqaayaddani ma furan tahay? Miis hal qof ah ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes, this table is free.
dialogue.somali: Haa, miiskan wuu bannaan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I see the menu, please?
dialogue.somali: Liiska cuntada ma arki karaa, fadlan?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Of course. Are you ready to order?
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Diyaar ma u tahay inaad dalbato?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes. I'd like rice and chicken.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Bariis iyo digaag ayaan rabaa.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Would you like anything to drink?
dialogue.somali: Wax cabitaan ah ma rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I have some water?
dialogue.somali: Biyo ma heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes. That's all, thank you.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Intaas ayaa igu filan, mahadsanid.

title: Fast Food: Ordering Food
situation: A customer orders a fast food meal, chooses a size and sauce, and asks for it to take away.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa dalbanaya cunto degdeg ah, cabbir iyo suugo dooranaya, kadibna codsanaya in loo qaado.
key_phrases: Can I have a burger meal, please?
Would you like small, medium, or large?
Is it to eat here or take away?
grammar_focus: To eat here or take away

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hi. I need some fast food. Can I have a burger meal, please?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Waxaan u baahanahay cunto degdeg ah. Burger meal ma heli karaa, fadlan?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Sure. Would you like small, medium, or large?
dialogue.somali: Haye. Yar, dhexe, mise weyn ayaad rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Medium, please, with fries.
dialogue.somali: Dhexe, fadlan, fries-na ha la socdaan.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: What sauce would you like?
dialogue.somali: Suugo noocee ah ayaad rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Garlic sauce, please.
dialogue.somali: Suugo toon ah, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Is it to eat here or take away?
dialogue.somali: Halkan ma ku cunaysaa mise waad qaadanaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Take away, please.
dialogue.somali: Waan qaadanayaa, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: That is seven dollars.
dialogue.somali: Waa toddoba doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Could I have a receipt?
dialogue.somali: Rasiid ma ii samayn kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes. Your food will be ready in five minutes.
dialogue.somali: Haa. Cuntadaadu shan daqiiqo gudahood ayay diyaar noqon doontaa.

title: Finding Groceries in the Store
situation: A customer asks where to find rice and tomatoes, checks the price, and pays at the checkout.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa weydiinaya halka bariis iyo yaanyo laga helo, qiimaha hubinaya, kadibna lacagta ku bixinaya khasnadda.
key_phrases: The rice is in aisle three, next to the flour.
How much are the tomatoes per kilo?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. I'm doing some grocery shopping. Where can I find rice?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Waxaan iibsanayaa alaab cunto. Bariiska xaggee ka heli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: The rice is in aisle three, next to the flour.
dialogue.somali: Bariisku wuxuu yaal safka saddexaad, burka agtiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you. Do you have small bags of rice?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Bacaha yaryar ee bariiska ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, we have one-kilo and five-kilo bags.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan haynaa bac hal kiilo ah iyo bac shan kiilo ah.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'll take one kilo. How much are the tomatoes per kilo?
dialogue.somali: Hal kiilo ayaan qaadanayaa. Yaanyadu kiiladii waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: They are two dollars per kilo today.
dialogue.somali: Maanta waa laba doolar kiiladii.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Are they fresh?
dialogue.somali: Ma cusub yihiin?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, they arrived this morning.
dialogue.somali: Haa, saaka ayay yimaadeen.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Great. Where is the checkout?
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Khasnaddu xaggee bay ku taallaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant
dialogue.english: It is at the front of the store.
dialogue.somali: Waxay ku taallaa dukaanka hortiisa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do you need a bag?
dialogue.somali: Bac ma u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, please, and a receipt.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan, rasiidna waan rabaa.

title: Choosing Fruit at the Market
situation: A customer buys fruit at a market, asks about ripeness and price, and avoids bruised fruit.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa suuqa ka iibsanaya miro, bisaylka iyo qiimaha weydiinaya, wuxuuna ka fogaanayaa miro dhaawacmay.
key_phrases: Are these mangoes ripe enough to eat today?
These ones are ripe, but those are still firm.
Please don't include any bruised fruit.
Can you add six bananas to the basket?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good morning. Are these mangoes ripe enough to eat today?
dialogue.somali: Subax wanaagsan. Cambahan ma u bisil yihiin in maanta la cuno?

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: These ones are ripe, but those are still firm.
dialogue.somali: Kuwan way bisil yihiin, laakiin kuwaas weli way adag yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'll take two kilos of the ripe mangoes.
dialogue.somali: Laba kiilo oo cambaha bisil ah ayaan qaadanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: All right. I will choose the soft ones for you.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Kuwa jilicsan ayaan kuu doorayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Please don't include any bruised fruit.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan ha ku darin miro dhaawacmay.

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: Of course. I will check each one.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Mid kasta waan hubinayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How much are the bananas?
dialogue.somali: Muusku waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: They are one dollar for six.
dialogue.somali: Lixda waa hal doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you add six bananas to the basket?
dialogue.somali: Lix muus ma ku dari kartaa dambiisha?

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: Yes. Do you want anything else?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Wax kale ma rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do you have a discount if I buy more fruits?
dialogue.somali: Qiimo dhimis ma jirtaa haddii aan miro badan iibsado?

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: For three kilos, I can reduce the price a little.
dialogue.somali: Saddex kiilo haddii aad qaadato, qiimaha xoogaa waan dhimi karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Two kilos are enough today. What is the total?
dialogue.somali: Laba kiilo maanta way igu filan yihiin. Wadarta waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: The total is seven dollars.
dialogue.somali: Wadartu waa toddoba doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Here is the money. Could you tie the bag, please?
dialogue.somali: Waa tan lacagtii. Bacda ma ii xiri kartaa, fadlan?

dialogue.speaker: Fruit seller
dialogue.english: Certainly. Keep the mangoes on top so they do not get crushed.
dialogue.somali: Hubaal. Cambaha dusha saar si aysan u burburin.

title: Buying Vegetables
situation: A customer buys vegetables at a small stall and asks for carrots and onions.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa khudaar ka iibsanaya miis yar wuxuuna codsanayaa karooto iyo basal.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. Do you have fresh vegetables?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Khudaar cusub ma haysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Vegetable seller
dialogue.english: Yes, the carrots and onions are fresh.
dialogue.somali: Haa, karootada iyo basashu way cusub yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I need carrots and onions.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay karooto iyo basal.

dialogue.speaker: Vegetable seller
dialogue.english: One small bag or one large bag?
dialogue.somali: Hal bac yar mise hal bac weyn?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: One small bag, please.
dialogue.somali: Hal bac yar, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Vegetable seller
dialogue.english: Here you are.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: How much is this bag?
dialogue.somali: Bacdan waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Vegetable seller
dialogue.english: That is three dollars.
dialogue.somali: Waa saddex doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Here is the money.
dialogue.somali: Waa tan lacagtii.

dialogue.speaker: Vegetable seller
dialogue.english: Thank you. Have a good day.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Maalin wanaagsan.

title: Buying Meat at the Butcher
situation: A customer buys halal meat at a butcher shop and asks for it to be cut into small pieces.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa hilib xalaal ah ka iibsanaya hilible wuxuuna codsanayaa in qaybo yaryar loo jarjaro.
key_phrases: I'd like one kilo of lamb.
Can you cut it into small pieces?
Do you want it with bone or without bone?
What is the price per kilo?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. Do you have halal meat?
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Hilib xalaal ah ma haysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Butcher
dialogue.english: Yes, all the meat here is halal.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hilibka halkan yaal oo dhan waa xalaal.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'd like one kilo of lamb.
dialogue.somali: Hal kiilo oo wan ah ayaan rabaa.

dialogue.speaker: Butcher
dialogue.english: Do you want it with bone or without bone?
dialogue.somali: Lafo ma ku rabtaa mise lafo la'aan?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: With bone, please. Can you cut it into small pieces?
dialogue.somali: Lafo ha lahaado, fadlan. Qaybo yaryar ma u jarjari kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Butcher
dialogue.english: Yes, I can cut it for stew.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan u jarjari karaa maraq.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: What is the price per kilo?
dialogue.somali: Qiimaha kiiladii waa imisa?

dialogue.speaker: Butcher
dialogue.english: It is nine dollars per kilo.
dialogue.somali: Kiiladii waa sagaal doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That's fine. Please put it in a bag.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Fadlan bac iigu rid.

dialogue.speaker: Butcher
dialogue.english: Here you are. The butcher counter is open until six.
dialogue.somali: Waa kan. Miiska hilibluhu wuxuu furan yahay ilaa lixda.

title: Ordering Drinks at a Cafe
situation: A customer orders drinks at a cafe, asks about milk options, sugar, ice, and takeaway cups.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa cabitaan ka dalbanaya kafateeri, wuxuuna weydiinayaa noocyada caanaha, sonkorta, barafka, iyo koobabka la qaato.
key_phrases: No sugar in the coffee, please.
Can you add ice to the tea?
Could you put them in takeaway cups?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hi. I'd like two drinks, please.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Laba cabitaan ayaan rabaa, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.english: Sure. What can I get for you?
dialogue.somali: Haye. Maxaan kuu keenaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: One coffee and one tea.
dialogue.somali: Hal kafee iyo hal shaah.

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.english: Do you want milk in the coffee?
dialogue.somali: Kafeega caano ma ku rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Do you have oat milk?
dialogue.somali: Caano oat ah ma haysaan?

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.english: Yes. Would you like sugar?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Sonkor ma rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: No sugar in the coffee, please.
dialogue.somali: Kafeega sonkor ha lagu darin, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.english: All right. Hot tea or iced tea?
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Shaah kulul mise shaah baraf leh?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Iced tea. Can you add ice to the tea?
dialogue.somali: Shaah baraf leh. Shaaha baraf ma ku dari kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.english: Yes. Do you want to drink them here?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Halkan ma ku cabaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: No, could you put them in takeaway cups?
dialogue.somali: Maya, koobab la qaato ma ku ridi kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Barista
dialogue.english: Sure. They will be ready at the end of the cafe counter.
dialogue.somali: Hubaal. Waxay diyaar ku noqon doonaan dhammaadka miiska kafateeriga.

title: Choosing Dessert After Dinner
situation: A customer asks about desserts after dinner, checks for nuts, chooses something less sweet, and adds a birthday message.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa cashada kadib weydiinaya macmacaan, lowska hubinaya, dooranaya wax aan aad u macaanayn, kadibna fariin dhalasho ku daraya.
key_phrases: Could we see the dessert menu?
Does the chocolate cake contain nuts?
Which dessert is not too sweet?
We'll share one cake and one ice cream.
Could you write Happy Birthday on the plate?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Excuse me, could we see the dessert menu?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo, liiska macmacaanka ma arki karnaa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Of course. Our desserts today are cake, ice cream, and fruit.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Macmacaanka maanta waa keeg, jalaato, iyo miro.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Does the chocolate cake contain nuts?
dialogue.somali: Keegga shukulaatada lows ma ku jiraa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes, it has almonds on top.
dialogue.somali: Haa, dusha waxaa kaga jira yicib.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Then we should avoid that. Which dessert is not too sweet?
dialogue.somali: Markaa waa inaan ka fogaannaa. Macmacaan kee aan aad u macaanayn?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: The vanilla ice cream is light, and the lemon cake is less sweet.
dialogue.somali: Jalaatada vaniladu waa fudud tahay, keegga liintuna macaan yar ayuu leeyahay.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can two people share the lemon cake?
dialogue.somali: Laba qof keegga liinta ma wadaagi karaan?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes, I can bring two spoons.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laba qaaddo ayaan keeni karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Great. We'll share one cake and one ice cream.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Hal keeg iyo hal jalaato ayaan wadaagaynaa.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Would you like them together or one after the other?
dialogue.somali: Ma wada rabtaan mise midba midka kale kadib?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Together, please. It is my sister's birthday.
dialogue.somali: Wada keen, fadlan. Waa dhalashada walaashay.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Happy birthday to her. Would you like a candle?
dialogue.somali: Dhalasho wanaagsan ha u ahaato. Shumac ma rabtaan?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, please. Could you write Happy Birthday on the plate?
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan. Saxanka ma ku qori kartaa Happy Birthday?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Certainly. I will write it in chocolate.
dialogue.somali: Hubaal. Shukulaato ayaan ku qori doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you. Please bring it after the tea.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Fadlan shaaha kadib keen.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Of course. I will bring everything in a few minutes.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Wax walba dhowr daqiiqo gudahood ayaan keeni doonaa.

title: Saying You Have a Food Allergy
situation: A customer tells a server about a food allergy and checks whether a dish contains nuts.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa adeegaha u sheegaya xasaasiyad cunto wuxuuna hubinayaa in saxan uu lows ku jiro.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Excuse me. I have a food allergy.
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo. Xasaasiyad cunto ayaan qabaa.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Thank you for telling me. What are you allergic to?
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad ii sheegtay. Maxaad xasaasiyad ku qabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Nuts. Does this dish have nuts?
dialogue.somali: Lows. Saxankan lows ma ku jiraa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Let me check the ingredients.
dialogue.somali: Aan hubiyo waxyaabaha ku jira.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you. I need safe food.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Waxaan u baahanahay cunto ammaan ah.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: The chicken salad is safe.
dialogue.somali: Saladhka digaaggu waa ammaan.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'll order that, please.
dialogue.somali: Kaas ayaan dalbanayaa, fadlan.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Of course. I will tell the kitchen about your allergies.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Jikada ayaan u sheegi doonaa xasaasiyaddaada.

title: Following a Simple Recipe
situation: A learner cooks with a friend and asks how to prepare rice and vegetables step by step.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa saaxiib la karinaya wuxuuna tallaabo-tallaabo u weydiinayaa sida bariis iyo khudaar loo diyaariyo.
key_phrases: Can you show me this recipe?
Chop the vegetables into small pieces.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Can you show me this recipe?
dialogue.somali: Cunto-karintan ma i tusi kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Sure. First, wash the rice.
dialogue.somali: Haye. Marka hore bariiska dhaq.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Do I put the rice in this pan?
dialogue.somali: Bariiska digsigaan ma ku ridayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Yes, then add water and a little salt.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kadibna biyo iyo cusbo yar ku dar.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: What should I do with the vegetables?
dialogue.somali: Khudaarta maxaan ku sameeyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Chop the vegetables into small pieces.
dialogue.somali: Khudaarta qaybo yaryar u jarjar.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: How long should it boil?
dialogue.somali: Intee in le'eg ayay karkaraysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Cook it for fifteen minutes.
dialogue.somali: Shan iyo toban daqiiqo kari.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Should I stir it?
dialogue.somali: Ma walaaqaa?

dialogue.speaker: Friend
dialogue.english: Yes, stir it once while the food is cooking.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hal mar walaaq inta cuntadu karinayso.

title: Finding Kitchen Tools
situation: A learner in a shared kitchen asks where to find tools and how to use them safely.
somali_situation: Arday ku jira jiko la wadaago ayaa weydiinaya halka qalabku yaal iyo sida si ammaan ah loogu isticmaalo.
key_phrases: Use the cutting board under the knife.
Put the lid on while it cooks.
Yes, after you wash the tools in the sink.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Where are the kitchen tools?
dialogue.somali: Qalabka jikadu xaggee buu yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Most of them are in the top drawer.
dialogue.somali: Intooda badan waxay ku jiraan khaanadda sare.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I need a knife and a cutting board.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay mindi iyo loox wax lagu jarjaro.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Use the cutting board under the knife.
dialogue.somali: Looxa wax lagu jarjaro hoos dhig mindida.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Can I use this pan?
dialogue.somali: Digsigan ma isticmaali karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Yes, but use a little oil first.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin marka hore saliid yar isticmaal.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Where is the lid for this pan?
dialogue.somali: Daboolka digsigan xaggee buu yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: It is beside the stove. Put the lid on while it cooks.
dialogue.somali: Wuxuu yaal foornada agteeda. Daboolka saar inta ay karinayso.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Should I dry everything with this towel?
dialogue.somali: Wax walba tuwaalkan ma ku qalajiyaa?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Yes, after you wash the tools in the sink.
dialogue.somali: Haa, kadib markaad qalabka ku dhaqdo saxanka.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thanks. I will put them back in the drawer.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Khaanadda ayaan dib ugu celin doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Perfect. That keeps the kitchen easy for everyone.
dialogue.somali: Waa hagaag. Taasi jikada qof walba ayay u fududaynaysaa.

title: Paying the Bill
situation: A customer asks for the bill, checks the service charge, splits the payment, and requests a receipt.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa biilka codsanaya, lacagta adeegga hubinaya, lacagta kala qaybinaya, kadibna rasiid codsanaya.
key_phrases: Could we have the bill, please?
I'll pay by card, and my friend will pay cash.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Excuse me, could we have the bill, please?
dialogue.somali: Iga raalli noqo, biilka ma heli karnaa, fadlan?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Of course. I'll bring it now.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Hadda ayaan keenayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Thank you. Is the service charge included?
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Lacagta adeeggu ma ku jirtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes, ten percent is included in the total.
dialogue.somali: Haa, boqolkiiba toban ayaa wadarta ku jira.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can we split the bill?
dialogue.somali: Biilka ma kala qaybin karnaa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes. How would you like to split it?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Sideed u rabtaan inaad u kala qaybisaan?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'll pay by card, and my friend will pay cash.
dialogue.somali: Anigu kaar ayaan ku bixinayaa, saaxiibkayna lacag caddaan ah ayuu bixinayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: No problem. Your part is twenty-two dollars.
dialogue.somali: Dhib ma leh. Qaybtaadu waa laba iyo labaatan doolar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I add a small tip on the card?
dialogue.somali: Kaariga ma ku dari karaa lacag yar oo mahadcelin ah?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes, choose the amount on the screen.
dialogue.somali: Haa, lacagta ka dooro shaashadda.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: The card machine says approved.
dialogue.somali: Mashiinka kaarku wuxuu leeyahay waa la aqbalay.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Great. I'll take your friend's cash now.
dialogue.somali: Wanaagsan. Hadda lacagta caddaanka ah ee saaxiibkaa ayaan qaadanayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Could we have a receipt?
dialogue.somali: Rasiid ma heli karnaa?

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Yes. Do you need one receipt or two?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Hal rasiid miyaad u baahan tihiin mise laba?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Two, please, because we are claiming expenses separately.
dialogue.somali: Laba, fadlan, sababtoo ah kharashka si kala gooni ah ayaan u gudbinaynaa.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Of course. Here are both receipts.
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Waa kuwan labada rasiid.

title: Ordering Food at the Counter
situation: A customer orders a simple meal at a counter and chooses whether to eat there.
somali_situation: Macmiil ayaa miiska ka dalbanaya cunto fudud wuxuuna dooranayaa inuu halkaas ku cuno.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Hello. I'd like to order food.
dialogue.somali: Salaan. Waxaan rabaa inaan cunto dalbado.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Of course. What would you like?
dialogue.somali: Dabcan. Maxaad rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I'd like soup and bread.
dialogue.somali: Maraq iyo rooti ayaan rabaa.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Is that for here?
dialogue.somali: Halkan ma ku cunaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, for here.
dialogue.somali: Haa, halkan ayaan ku cunayaa.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Anything else?
dialogue.somali: Wax kale ma rabtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: No, just the meal.
dialogue.somali: Maya, cuntadaas oo keliya.

dialogue.speaker: Server
dialogue.english: Thank you. Please wait at the counter.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Fadlan miiska agtiisa ku sug.

title: Storing Leftover Food
situation: Two housemates store leftover food safely and decide what goes in the fridge or freezer.
somali_situation: Laba qof oo guri wada deggan ayaa si ammaan ah u kaydinaya cunto hartay waxayna go'aaminayaan waxa qaboojiyaha ama barafeeyaha la geliyo.
key_phrases: Where should I put the leftover food?
Put it in a clean container.
Should it go in the fridge or the freezer?
Write today's date on the label.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: I'm learning food storage. Where should I put the leftover food?
dialogue.somali: Waxaan baranayaa kaydinta cuntada. Cuntada hartay xaggee baan dhigaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Put it in a clean container.
dialogue.somali: Ku rid weel nadiif ah.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Should it go in the fridge or the freezer?
dialogue.somali: Qaboojiyaha ma gelinayaa mise barafeeyaha?

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Put tonight's food in the fridge.
dialogue.somali: Cuntada caawa geli qaboojiyaha.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: What about the soup?
dialogue.somali: Maraqana maxaa laga yeelayaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: The soup can go in the freezer.
dialogue.somali: Maraqku wuxuu geli karaa barafeeyaha.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Should I write the expiry date?
dialogue.somali: Taariikhda uu dhacayo ma qoro?

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Yes, write today's date on the label.
dialogue.somali: Haa, taariikhda maanta ku qor calaamadda.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Can I reheat it tomorrow?
dialogue.somali: Berri dib ma u kululeyn karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Cook
dialogue.english: Yes, but reheat it only once.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin hal mar oo keliya dib u kululee.
